Aspects of the Crucible: Wings.location: Dropped by Black Knight Edredd at Fort of Reprimand (Scadu Altus, south of Moorth Highway).

Assassin's Gambit.location: Sold by Knight Bernahl at Volcano Manor for 6,500 Runes after completing the first Volcano Manor contract.

Beast's Roar.location: Reward from Gurranq, Beast Clergyman at the Bestial Sanctum (Dragonbarrow) after giving him the fourth Deathroot.

Black Flame Tornado.location: Dropped by the Godskin Duo boss in the Dragon Temple area of Crumbling Farum Azula.

Blind Spot.location: Comes equipped on the Backhand Blades found beside a coffin in the Inquisitor enemy area of Gravesite Plain, near the first site of grace.

Blinkbolt.location: Found in a chest in Fog Rift Catacombs (southeast Rauh region); reach it via the third spike-trap room, drop and ride the alcove notch up.

Blood Blade.location: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in Altus Plateau, northeast of Erdtree-Gazing Hill, flying above a pond.

Bloody Slash.location: Dropped by a Godrick Knight fought atop the ramparts of Fort Haight in Limgrave.

Braggart's Roar.location: Dropped by Blackguard Big Boggart, or obtained after completing the Dung Eater questline.

Buckler Parry.location: Default skill of the Buckler shield, bought from Gatekeeper Gostoc in Stormveil Castle (1,500 Runes) after defeating Godrick; skill is bound to the Buckler.

Carian Grandeur.location: Found on a corpse atop an archway in the graveyard area of Caria Manor (Liurnia of the Lakes), below the Manor Upper Level grace.

Carian Greatsword.location: Bought from Sorcerer Rogier (at Stormveil Castle or Roundtable Hold) for 2,500 Runes, or from the Twin Maiden Husks after turning in Rogier's Bell Bearing.

Carian Sovereignty.location: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab clinging to the ceiling of a cave southwest of the Cathedral of Manus Metyr (Church District, Scadu Altus).

Charge Forth.location: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab on the underside of a broken bridge west-northwest of the Academy Gate Town grace in Liurnia.

Chilling Mist.location: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in the ruins south of Renna's Rise (Three Sisters, Liurnia), accessible after defeating Royal Knight Loretta in Caria Manor.

Determination.location: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab on the path at the bridge north of Agheel Lake in Limgrave.

Double Slash.location: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab at Sellia, Town of Sorcery in Caelid.

Dryleaf Whirlwind.location: Found northeast of the Rauh Ancient Ruins, East site of grace, on an edge beside a column near a waterfall.

Earthshaker.location: Dropped by an invisible Teardrop Scarab near the Grand Lift of Dectus on the Altus Plateau; only appears at night.

Enchanted Shot.location: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab hiding behind a rock near a brazier, north of the Ancestral Woods grace in Nokron, Eternal City.

Endure.location: Sold by Knight Bernahl at the Warmaster's Shack (Limgrave) for 600 Runes.

Eruption.location: Sold by Knight Bernahl at Volcano Manor for 8,000 Runes.

Firebreather.location: Default skill of the Steel-Wire Torch found in the upper levels of Castle Morne (Weeping Peninsula).

Flame Skewer.location: Dropped by NPC invader Fire Knight Queelign on the second encounter, at the Church of the Crusade in Scadu Altus.

Flame Spear.location: Dropped by a Fire Knight at the end of the bridge on the sixth floor of Shadow Keep.

Flame of the Redmanes.location: Dropped by an invisible Teardrop Scarab in front of the Fort Gael North site of grace in Caelid.

Flaming Strike.location: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in the graveyard on the south cliffside behind Redmane Castle (Caelid).

Ghostflame Call.location: Dropped by the Death Rite Bird in the partly-sunken graveyard reached from the Charo's Hidden Grave site of grace.

Giant Hunt.location: Dropped by the Night's Cavalry in northern Liurnia between Bellum Church and East Raya Lucaria Gate; appears only at night.

Glintblade Phalanx.location: Comes attached to Rogier's Rapier, received from Sorcerer Rogier at the Roundtable Hold after defeating Godrick; extract the skill at a grace.

Golden Land.location: Dropped by a scarab south of the Great Waterfall Crest grace in Deeproot Depths, behind the Erdtree Avatar.

Golden Slam.location: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab inside a building of the Woodfolk Ruins, next to the Minor Erdtree on the Altus Plateau.

Gravitas.location: Dropped by a Lesser Alabaster Lord roaming the beach by the stone arch near the Seaside Ruins grace in south Limgrave.

Ground Slam.location: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab west of the Minor Erdtree in the Mistwood, Limgrave.

Hoarah Loux's Earthshaker.location: Trade the Remembrance of Hoarah Loux with Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

Hoarfrost Stomp.location: Dropped by an invisible Teardrop Scarab in the shallow water southeast of Caria Manor (Liurnia); track its glowing footprints.

Holy Ground.location: Obtained by destroying the three Chariots in Auriza Hero's Grave (drops with the Tree Sentinel armor set).

Igon's Drake Hunt.location: Comes on Igon's Greatbow; looted from Igon's body southeast of the Foot of the Jagged Peak grace after summoning him for the Bayle fight.

Impaling Thrust.location: Sold by Knight Bernahl at the Warmaster's Shack (Limgrave) for 1,200 Runes.

Kick.location: Sold by Knight Bernahl at the Warmaster's Shack (Limgrave) for 800 Runes.

Lightning Ram.location: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab just south of the Sainted Hero's Grave on the Altus Plateau.

Lion's Claw.location: Dropped by the Lion Guardian boss at Fort Gael in Caelid.

Loretta's Slash.location: Dropped by the Royal Knight Loretta boss in Caria Manor (Liurnia of the Lakes).

No Skill.location: Sold by Knight Bernahl at the Warmaster's Shack (Limgrave) for 600 Runes, or from the Twin Maiden Husks after his Bell Bearing.

Overhead Stance.location: Comes equipped on the Great Katana found beside the sleeping Ghostflame Dragon on the lake west of the Ellac Greatbridge (Abandoned Ailing Village area).

Palm Blast.location: Won by defeating Dryleaf Dane at Moorth Ruins (Scadu Altus) using the 'May the Best Win' gesture.

Parry.location: Sold by Knight Bernahl at the Warmaster's Shack (Limgrave) for 600 Runes, or from the Twin Maiden Husks after his Bell Bearing.

Piercing Fang.location: Comes on the Nagakiba received during Bloody Finger Hunter Yura's questline, or by killing Yura (first found at Murkwater, Limgrave).

Piercing Throw.location: Found on a scarab guarded by Misbegotten just east of the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past grace (Scadu Altus).

Prayerful Strike.location: Dropped by an invisible Teardrop Scarab under the short rocky tunnel on the lake by the western entrance to Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Prelate's Charge.location: Dropped by a scarab hanging on a tree in a Fire Monk campsite south of the Whiteridge Road grace in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

Quickstep.location: Sold by Knight Bernahl at the Warmaster's Shack (Limgrave) for 800 Runes.

Raging Beast.location: Dropped by a teleporting Teardrop Scarab in the trees north of the Bridge Leading to the Village grace (Bonny Village area, Scadu Altus).

Raptor of the Mists.location: Received after aiding Bloody Finger Hunter Yura in defeating his target at Raya Lucaria.

Repeating Thrust.location: Dropped by the Night's Cavalry at the Agheel Lake North bridge in Limgrave (appears at night).

Rolling Sparks.location: Looted from a flying scarab on the eastern side of the large camp south of Shadow Keep, atop the hill past the perfumers (Scadu Altus).

Royal Knight's Resolve.location: Found in a lower room past the imp-locked door in Volcano Manor, reached from the Temple of Eiglay grace.

Sacred Blade.location: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab next to a Spiritspring north of the Third Church of Marika in Limgrave.

Sacred Ring of Light.location: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in the Aeonian Swamp east of the Heart of Aeonia grace in Caelid.

Savage Lion's Claw.location: Found in a small camp by following the left wall north from the Three-Path Cross grace in Gravesite Plain.

Scattershot Throw.location: On a scarab hanging high on a pillar with Misbegotten beneath, just south of Taylew's Ruined Forge near a bridge (Scadu Altus).

Seppuku.location: Dropped by an invisible scarab on the frozen lake east of the Freezing Lake grace in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

Shared Order.location: Dropped by the Night's Cavalry next to the Altus Highway Junction grace on the Altus Plateau.

Shield Bash.location: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab on an island beneath the broken bridge between Raya Lucaria Academy and the East Raya Lucaria Gate (Liurnia).

Shield Crash.location: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in a structure behind the upper Lux Ruins on the Altus Plateau.

Shield Strike.location: Comes pre-equipped on the Dueling Shield found in the Storehouse at Shadow Keep.

Shriek of Sorrow.location: Found behind the great tree in the central Main Plaza of Belurat, Tower Settlement (where Fire Knight Queelign invades).

Sky Shot.location: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab on the cliffs northwest of the Isolated Merchant's Shack in Dragonbarrow.

Spectral Lance.location: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab past the wooden bridge in the graveyard east of the Church of the Cuckoo grace.

Spinning Gravity Thrust.location: Comes equipped on the Sword Lance, a reward for trading the Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider with Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

Spinning Slash.location: Sold by Knight Bernahl at the Warmaster's Shack (Limgrave) for 1,200 Runes.

Spinning Strikes.location: Comes on the Banished Knight's Halberd dropped by Edgar when killed at Castle Morne (or when he invades at Revenger's Shack).

Stamp (Sweep).location: Dropped by an invisible Teardrop Scarab on the western Limgrave beaches.

Stamp (Upward Cut).location: Sold by Knight Bernahl at the Warmaster's Shack (Limgrave) for 1,500 Runes.

Storm Assault.location: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab within Stormveil Castle.

Storm Blade.location: Sold by Knight Bernahl at the Warmaster's Shack (Limgrave) for 1,800 Runes.

Storm Stomp.location: Found in a chest in the underground room in the southeastern area of Gatefront Ruins, Limgrave (with the Whetstone Knife).

Storm Wall.location: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab on an outcropping west of the collapsed bridge, north of Stormhill Shack (Stormhill, Limgrave).

Swift Slash.location: Reward for siding with Hornsent against Leda during his fight at Shadow Keep.

Thops's Barrier.location: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab at the Church of Irith (Liurnia) after delivering the Academy Glintstone Key to Thops (or after lighting the Forge of the Giants).

Through and Through.location: Dropped by an invisible Teardrop Scarab patrolling a loop just outside Volcano Manor on the Altus Plateau.

Torch Attack.location: Default skill found on torch armaments (e.g. the basic Torch); not acquired as a standalone Ash of War.

Unsheathe.location: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab standing in the water at Agheel Lake, Limgrave.

Vacuum Slice.location: On a corpse inside the waterfall-surrounded ruined temple at the bottom level, southwest of the Across the Roots grace in Deeproot Depths.

Vow of the Indomitable.location: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab on an island in the poison swamp of southeastern Liurnia, south of the Folly on the Lake grace.

Wall of Sparks.location: On a corpse sitting on the rails in the first-floor Storehouse of Shadow Keep (take the left lift down).

War Cry.location: Sold by Knight Bernahl at the Warmaster's Shack (Limgrave) for 800 Runes.

Waves of Darkness.location: Trade the Remembrance of the Naturalborn (Starscourge Radahn) with Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

White Shadow's Lure.location: Dropped by an invisible Teardrop Scarab (chased by wolves) northwest of the Inner Consecrated Snowfield grace, toward Ordina.

Wild Strikes.location: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab on the path leading up to Stormveil Castle.

Wing Stance.location: In a chest in a tower below the Castle Lord's Chamber grace at Castle Ensis; drop off the edge and follow the cliffside down.
